purpose: Original Mist Ridge cooperative platform game direction art

images.prompt: Create an original premium 2D side-scrolling cooperative exploration game background, landscape 1536x1024. A remote alpine observatory at blue hour, layered mountain peaks and cloud valleys, weathered slate rock, pine silhouettes, distant amber lamps and a tiny stone observatory tower near far right, quiet mist and clear cool atmospheric depth. Mature adventurous illustrated game art, painterly but crisp, art-directed cyan blue and midnight ink with amber accents, polished commercial indie concept quality. Camera perfectly side-on horizontal platform game presentation, no isometric angle. Upper half sweeping mountains and clouds. Central band from 35% to 78% height mostly open muted cloud valley suitable for overlaying interactive platforms and human explorers. Foreground bottom edge rugged dark rock and sparse pine, clear uncluttered playable band. No characters, no visible traversable foreground platforms or gameplay props, no UI, no letters, no logos, no mockup borders. This is a background texture for an actual game, not a whole screenshot. Fine foliage and geological detail at edges, softly restrained center.

Produce one original high-quality 2D game prop sprite atlas on genuine transparent alpha background, exactly three equal columns by two equal rows (six separate sprites) in a landscape 1536x1024 image. Each sprite centered entirely inside its own 512x512 cell with transparent margin; no neighboring cell overlap, no labels or grid. Consistent premium hand-painted alpine observatory adventure game art, side-view straight camera, slate blue stone, aged brass, small amber lights, clean silhouettes with textured details. Top row left: a single chunky square slate stone platform block, top horizontal lip and textured front face, sized to tile seamlessly at edges; top middle: same square stone block sheathed in luminous translucent cyan ice crystalline surface, obvious frozen hazard; top right: a tall closed brass lattice mechanical gate in a weathered stone frame, front-on side-game object, compact width and vertical height. Bottom left: a low brass pressure pad console on a short slate base, amber circular illuminated center, readable when flattened into floor; bottom middle: a warm lantern on a small decorated metal checkpoint pedestal; bottom right: an open elegant alpine observatory doorway / exit arch with amber beacon light, weathered stone and bronze framed doorway. All ground-based props, isolated objects, crisp cinematic painted shading not pixel art, no isometric angle. Real alpha outside each object.

Create an original 2D side-scrolling character sprite atlas with genuine transparent background, landscape 1536x1024, EXACT 4 columns and 2 rows, eight equal 384x512 cells. All characters fully visible, centered in each cell with feet aligned to bottom 10% line, constant scale and clean transparent margins, no letters, no frames, no overlapping cells. Premium hand-painted indie adventure game style, detailed mature adult explorers, elegant side-view silhouette, readable at 80 pixels height, proportionate adult bodies, no chibi, no photographic people, no guns. Upper row four frames of same woman explorer wearing midnight-teal mountain jacket, tan hiking trousers, brass amber lamp on belt, pale scarf, short auburn hair: left-to-right standing side-on facing right, running right left leg forward, running right right leg forward, airborne jumping right with knees tucked. Bottom row the same four poses for same adult man companion wearing rust-ochre mountaineering jacket, charcoal trousers, blue scarf, dark hair, belt lantern. Both expressive but restrained. Consistent warm rim lights and cool blue shadows, original costume designs, crisp painted material detail. Every pose faces right for runtime horizontal flipping; true transparent alpha outside subjects. No scenery.
